entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I'm calling about an order I received two days ago for a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Ben Carter, and the order is VF-98221.

Thank you, Ben. I see your order for the Pro-Carbon cycling shoes, delivered on January 19th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?
It's definitely a fit issue. I installed my cleats and went for a short ride, but I got some pretty bad blisters on my heels. They just don't seem to be the right shape for my feet.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Since you are well within our 90-day return window for standard items, I can absolutely process a return for a full refund.

Okay, a full refund works for me. That's great. I do have one question, though. Since I went through the hassle of unboxing, installing the cleats, and now have to repackage everything, would you be able to add a 10% discount code to my account for a future purchase? I still plan to buy another pair from VeloFit.

I appreciate you wanting to stick with VeloFit, Ben, and I understand your request. However, our policy doesn't allow for goodwill credits or discounts on returns related to sizing or personal preference. I can assure you the return process itself is very straightforward.
I see. So no discount code at all? Not even 5% for the inconvenience?
I'm afraid not, but I can get the free return label sent to your email immediately. As soon as we receive the cycling shoes back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed right away.
Alright, that's fair enough. A quick and easy refund is the most important thing. Please go ahead and send that label.
Of course. I've just sent the prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You should receive it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Ben. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
